title: Annual Start Date and Credited Days of a Professional Email Annual Conversion
content:
Plan change rule. The annual start date and the credited days of a Professional Email annual conversion are read from where today falls in the paid month:

| Where today falls | Annual term starts on | Credited days |
|---|---|---|
| the paid month began fewer than 5 calendar days before today | the paid month's start date | every day of the month |
| the term end date is 3 calendar days or fewer after today | the term end date | none |
| otherwise | today | the calendar days from today to the term end date |

## Edges (hypothetical paid month from 12 June to 12 July, 30 days)

| Today | Days since the month began / days to its end | Annual term starts | Credited days |
|---|---|---|---|
| 16 June | 4 since | 12 June | 30 |
| 17 June | 5 since | 17 June | 25 |
| 8 July | 4 to the end | 8 July | 4 |
| 9 July | 3 to the end | 12 July | 0 |
